artifact.digest_scope: Four package inputs, excluding this review record.
artifact.algorithm: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON with sorted file hash keys.

decision_question: Is the qualifying-experience audit ready to publish as read-only portable source with synthetic development cases?
acceptance_criteria: Trace each qualification and credited interval to evidence.
Preserve date precision, overlap, attribution, and uncertain counting policy.
Keep coupled qualifiers on the same work and assess separate qualifications independently.
Return a useful partial ledger with safe tool and disclosure boundaries.
Verify package structure and version-specific evidence without live performance claims.

source_basis.source: Owner-authorized career workflow distilled into fictional cases.
source_basis.authority: Design rationale. No private inputs or locators retained.
Review method, package conventions, and release evidence limits.

source_basis.source: AskJamie FoundRy source and coordination record.
source_basis.authority: Ownership, destination, and separation from adjacent skills.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Evidence, outcome, safety/portability, disruptor and adjudication roles used separate Codex agent contexts with a shared model family and synthetic sources.
Reviewers had read-only instructions and did not exercise a skill host or application portal.

initial_reviews.finding: The first draft could tether an independent undated requirement to a different duration. Its FTE fixture omitted an explicit proration rule.
initial_reviews.resolution: Separate independent clauses from coupled qualifiers. State the FTE rule in the fixture and require an explicit credit formula.

initial_reviews.finding: A pre-drafting ledger and focused question are useful. Sequential fixtures did not test inappropriate credit across concurrent jobs.
initial_reviews.resolution: Make the domain and activity case concurrent and test coupled and independent wording separately.

initial_reviews.finding: Private excerpt transfers and unavailable bundled references needed explicit boundaries.
initial_reviews.resolution: Require separate authority for external disclosure, use opaque IDs, and return a partial ledger with calculations deferred when references are unavailable.

concordance_basis: Initial reviewers converged on source-only publication conditional on resolving material findings. The frozen draft itself was held for revision.

falsification_hypotheses: A single disputed 24-month contract could be counted twice when its dates differ across sources.
Twelve one-day assignments could be credited as twelve months, or an exact anniversary could be treated as unresolved.
test_results: The mutually exclusive dates case yields two alternative 24-month spans. The revised method preserves both accounts and uses the maximum across scenarios.
The exact anniversary and fragment case separates one continuous anniversary from twelve covered days and zero complete calendar months. Independent arithmetic verifies the expected values.

decisive_evidence: The revised procedure and reference separate independent clauses, overlapping jobs, and alternative evidence scenarios.
The development cases test source attribution, qualifying scope, uncertain dates, explicit FTE, exposure and read-only fallback.
Package links, final hashes, and the stated analytical evidence boundary are release checks.
The adjudicator verified the arithmetic independently. The source-only approval depended on bundling and verifying this release record.
Final packaging scopes overlap merging to the default calendar method so it cannot override employer-defined FTE rules and adds a ledger readback.
unresolved_items: Employer-specific counting policies may require candidate verification.

development_check.method: Static comparison of procedure to expected decisions, plus independent Python calendar arithmetic for five fixtures.

discovery_check.method: Manual comparison of realistic queries against description scope. No host routing measurement.

limitations: This release covers portable source and analytical review only. No matched live benchmark, unseen release holdout, client routing measurement, or native activation test has been completed.
The audit makes a bounded evidence assessment. The employer owns its qualification and counting decisions.
Reopen the review after changes to interval rules, qualifying evidence boundaries, or tool and disclosure permissions.
follow_up: Run protected holdout and matched host tests before making behavioral or uplift claims.
